claude_proposed_widenings.name: magic-item activation effect for commanded item locomotion
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current magic-item activation family exists, and `Attachment.item` exists, but there is no honest effect shape for making an item hover/fly as a directed vehicle instead of granting a creature a speed or creating a companion.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can make this carpet hover and fly by taking a Magic action and using the carpet's command word. It moves according to your directions if you are within 30 feet of it.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: load-dependent speed modifier on item locomotion
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The carpet's speed depends on whether its carried weight exceeds normal capacity, which is not expressible with the current surface's speed atoms or predicates.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A carpet can carry up to twice the weight shown on the table, but its Fly Speed is halved if it carries more than its normal capacity.
